description: Pain detection model trained on PEMF (Pain E-Motion Faces Database). Comparative model: takes target face + reference face, outputs pain score via feature subtraction. Warm-started from TaatiTeam UNBC checkpoint.
trained_on: PEMF (68 subjects, 5320 frames, algometer + laser + posed + neutral pain types)
source: Algoscope custom training (warm-start from TaatiTeam/pain_detection_demo epoch 13)
output: Single sigmoid value (0-1). Maps to 0-10 pain scale.
notes: Reference frame provided by calibration (patient's face at known pain level). Falls back to zero reference when uncalibrated. License: UHN non-commercial research (inherited from warm-start weights).
